textRuns.value: Source: EFFIS burnt-area perimeters (Copernicus EMS / JRC), European countries, 2016 to 2026. The five-year normal is a trailing mean of the previous five years, excluding the year plotted. The season anomaly truncates both the current year and the baseline at the last month carrying data, so a season in progress is compared like for like. EFFIS under-counts small fires: totals are a floor.
